sources.name: Bengaluru City Police: Law & Order
sources.note: Authority for law-and-order, CEN and women police stations, their division and phone numbers.

sources.name: Bengaluru City Police: Traffic
sources.note: Traffic police stations by traffic division with phone numbers, cross-checked against btp.

sources.name: Bengaluru City Police: Cyber Crime Police Station
sources.note: City-wide Cyber Crime Police Station in the Commissioner's office premises; also states that 8 CEN police stations exist.

sources.name: Bengaluru City Police: Overview
sources.note: States the current law-and-order divisions (zones), each headed by a DCP.

sources.name: Bengaluru City Police: Senior Officers list
sources.note: Names a DCP for each law-and-order division (West and East zones) and for the four traffic divisions.

sources.name: Bengaluru Traffic Police: Traffic Police Station Locator
sources.note: Authority for traffic police stations, their traffic division (DCP) and phone numbers. Its coordinates break ties between OSM matches and, when they pass the checks in coordinate_rule, place stations that OSM and the geocoder do not (official_btp).

sources.name: Karnataka State Police: Police Station Locator, Bengaluru City (linked from the BCP site)
sources.note: Used to link alternate official names and to corroborate OSM matches. When they pass the checks in coordinate_rule its coordinates place stations that OSM, the geocoder and the BTP locator do not (official_ksp); many of its values are invalid and are dropped. Addresses are not copied: they are cut at 45 characters at the source.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API (amenity=police)
sources.note: Coordinates of matched stations; query bbox (12.7, 77.25, 13.35, 77.95) (S, W, N, E). ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap relation 2020589 (Bengaluru Urban)
sources.note: No OSM boundary=police relation for the Bengaluru City Police was found (Overpass search of boundary=police relations in 12.7-13.35 N, 77.25-77.95 E), so the Bengaluru Urban district boundary is used

sources.name: Nominatim geocoder (OpenStreetMap data)
sources.note: Only for official stations without an OSM match, bounded to (77.37, 12.83, 77.88, 13.15) (lon/lat); a result is kept only if its name carries the station's place and kind, and results more than 500 m apart are treated as ambiguous.

coordinate_rule: A position comes from the matched OpenStreetMap feature (osm), else from a Nominatim result named for the station (geocoded), else from the station's BTP locator position and then its KSP locator position (official_btp, official_ksp), each accepted only if it either lies inside the Bengaluru Urban district polygon and within 8 km of the centroid of OSM-located stations in the same official division (the five-way division when that official division has fewer than 3), or lies outside the district polygon, at any distance, and within 10 km of an OSM-located station that is itself outside the district (cluster check); is not within 50 m of another station's position of the same kind in the same locator; and, for a traffic or women station, lies within 3 km of the OSM position of the law-and-order station of the same place; otherwise it is null.
division_rule: Official divisions named Central, North, South, East or West (including the Traffic East, West, North and South divisions) keep that name, and every other official division is assigned whole to the one of these five whose centroid, the mean coordinate of the stations with coordinates in that law-and-order division, is nearest to its own centroid.
